product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx is an AI-powered employee-experience platform for enterprise HR teams and leaders that combines employee listening, analytics, coaching, and learning to turn workforce feedback into action and capability development.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer do not publish a pricing link or plan catalogue; commercial calls to action lead to sales/demo conversations.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying technical posts describe building the production sentiment model and the PYX-Voice benchmark harness. Their co-authors include AI/data-engineering leader Noel D’Souza and harness builder Andy Horng; PYX Labs is Perceptyx’s research lab.

public_docs.notes: Public help articles cover AI Coach governance, action planning/intelligent nudges, and interpreting survey results.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public jobs listing includes Senior Machine Learning Engineer; the linked supporting job description covers NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (GPT-4.1, GPT-4o mini, GPT-5), Anthropic, and Google; also proprietary Perceptyx models.
model_provider.notes: The model-governance document names OpenAI models for Comment Copilot and AI Coach; the August 2026 transparency overview names OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google for optional generative features.

compliance_certs.notes: The FAQ claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest recorded round: July 21, 2021, associated with FundersClub; no disclosed USD amount was found. This database record is not corroborated by a standalone financing announcement and coincides with the Waggl acquisition period. The latest directly announced cash investment found was TCV growth equity on August 12, 2019, also undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent recorded round predates May 9, 2025; no later round was identified. The last directly announced investment also predates the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open listings include Enterprise Sales Development Representative and Enterprise Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Perceptyx Anywhere launched September 29, 2026, inside the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mary Poppen joined as Chief Customer Officer in June 2026; her June 25, 2026 post says she joined earlier that month.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Customer Marketing Manager description explicitly says to leverage Salesforce and HubSpot for automated lifecycle journeys. That posting is closed; it supports stack usage, not current hiring.
